# 🌌 OrbitalFFA

## ⚔️ About
Welcome to **OrbitalFFA**, a next-generation Minecraft FFA server built around fast-paced PvP, custom combat mechanics, and unique gameplay.

Whether you're looking to dominate the leaderboards, master custom weapons, or simply enjoy competitive PvP, OrbitalFFA has something for everyone.

---

# ✨ Features

## ⚔️ Custom Combat
• Unique weapons & abilities
• Balanced PvP mechanics
• Competitive gameplay

## 📦 Custom Kits
• Free starter kit
• Unlock powerful donor kits
• Progress through exclusive ranks

## 🔥 Killstreaks
• Earn rewards as your streak increases
• Dominate the arena
• Show everyone who's on top

## 🚀 Performance
• Optimized for smooth gameplay
• Low latency combat
• Frequent updates & improvements

## 🎮 Server
• Minecraft Java Edition
• Version **1.21.11+**
• Active development
• Friendly community

---

# ❤️ Support

Purchasing a rank helps support the server and allows us to continue developing new features, hosting events, and improving OrbitalFFA for everyone.

Thank you for supporting OrbitalFFA!

See you in the arena. ⚔️
